overview_description.description: Simply put, Asurion helps people stay connected. As the global leader of connected life services, they provide over 290 million consumers around the world with simple, intuitive technology advice to help them get the most from their devices; support to fix their issues and connectivity crisis, and device protection to ensure they receive a replacement or repair. When a product is missing or simply doesn't work properly, Asurion’s 17,000 employees are focused on solving the problem with people and processes operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week, speaking six languages, and working across any device, platform, or provider. By partnering with leading retailers, mobile carriers and pay-tv providers, Asurion helps customers enhance their lives through their technology.

about_short_description.short_description: Asurion is an electronics company that provides protection, repair, and installation.

product.name: Device Protection Plans
product.description: Insurance and extended-warranty coverage for phones, tablets, wearables, consumer electronics, home technology, and appliances, including repair, replacement, or reimbursement for eligible incidents.

product.name: Mobile Protection
product.description: Protection for eligible phones, tablets, and connected wearables against loss, theft, accidental damage, liquid damage, and certain out-of-warranty malfunctions.

product.name: Asurion Home+
product.description: A multi-device protection and support plan for household electronics, including repairs or replacements and technical assistance for covered devices.

product.name: Asurion Appliance+
product.description: Protection for eligible home appliances that provides repair or replacement support for covered breakdowns and appliance-related service needs.

product.name: uBreakiFix by Asurion Repair Services
product.description: In-store, mail-in, and mobile repair services for smartphones, computers, tablets, gaming consoles, appliances, and other electronic devices.

product.name: Cracked Screen Repair
product.description: Repair of eligible cracked smartphone screens through Asurion-certified technicians, available at participating locations and in some same-day service areas.
